title: Concordia check-result predicate v1
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement v1 with predicateType https://concordia.io/evidence/check-result/v1: a named check had an outcome for a revision and an environment. The subject is usually the revision (`gitCommit`). The schema is open: Concordia ignores fields that it does not list and does not persist them. `covers` is required and an empty list is a statement that the result covers nothing; a missing `covers` is a missing field. A `time` or a `window` with `start` and `end` is required.

revision.description: The source revision that the check ran against. It must equal the evaluated revision.

evidence.description: Evidence that backs the result, for example a test report, with digests.

window.description: Used instead of `time`. The maximum age counts from `end`.

covers.description: The control, node, and scenario identifiers that the result covers. An empty list covers nothing.
